service.description: Executes multi-turn agent tool execution loop against OpenAI-compatible REST endpoints.
Searches historical AgiPayload entries for APE and client inspection.

actions.script:
List results = [] rawList.each { pld -> def facetList = ec.entity.find("org.moqui.ai.payload.AgiPayloadFacet") .condition("agiPayloadId", pld.agiPayloadId) .list() Map facetMap = [:] facetList.each { f -> facetMap[f.facetKey] = f.facetValue }
results.add([ agiPayloadId : pld.agiPayloadId, title : pld.title ?: (pld.userPromptText ? (pld.userPromptText.take(45) + "...") : "Untitled"), userPromptText : pld.userPromptText, modeEnumId : pld.modeEnumId, statusId : pld.statusId, artifactUri : pld.artifactUri, targetMariaId : pld.targetMariaId, lastUpdatedStamp : pld.lastUpdatedStamp?.toString(), facets : facetMap ]) } context.payloadList = results

service.description: Central dispatcher validating, storing, and staging AgiPayload envelopes.
Dynamically composes a layered system instruction Markdown prompt: Base Foundations -> Operational Mode Directives -> Artifact Directives -> Situational Context -> Facet Overlays.
